records.name: Regular Void and Elite Void factual timing boundaries
records.scope: Factual Pest Control boat gates, regular Void shop costs, and Elite Void upgrade inputs. Whether to wait for Veteran, buy any helmet, pursue Elite Void, or place this activity in a route is strategy-only.

pest_control_boats.observation_boundary: Boat availability, team formation, activity eligibility, round success, points, and elapsed time are player-observed. The boat requirement does not establish a win or outcome.

regular_void.boundary: Regular Void may be purchased through any qualifying lower boat when its own purchase skill gates and an observed point balance are met. Combat 100 only opens Veteran.

elite_void.boundary: The two upgrades are explicit deterministic transactions only after an observed hard-diary claim, observed regular top or robe, observed point balance, and confirmed upgrade.

non_inferences: No lander, world, team, win, point award, points per hour, purchase, upgrade, equipment state, diary completion, combat readiness, or route position is inferred.
The analysis never treats Combat 100 as a regular Void requirement or treats the Veteran point rate as a guaranteed outcome.
